title: Self-Evolving Agents through Privileged Retrospective Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27495v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-evolving agents aim to improve from their own experience rather than remain fixed after deployment, but naturally collected trajectories often lack ground-truth solutions or verifier-derived rewards. We introduce Retrospective Self-Distillation (RSD), a multi-round framework that turns such experience into dense supervision using privileged retrospective context. For each on-policy trajectory, the same underlying model acts as both student and teacher: the teacher re-scores the student's realized actions while conditioning on cross-task precedents and lessons, together with turn-level reflection and future hindsight from the completed trajectory. The resulting teacher distribution is distilled back into the policy through on-policy self-distillation. Across rounds, the experience bank grows and the retrospective context is refreshed, allowing the model, its data, and its supervision to co-evolve. We further introduce frontier-guid

translated_title: 通过特权回溯蒸馏实现自我进化的智能体
translated_abstract: 自我进化的智能体旨在从自身经验中持续改进，而非在部署后保持固定不变，但自然收集的轨迹往往缺乏真实标准答案或由验证器导出的奖励信号。我们提出了回溯自蒸馏（Retrospective Self-Distillation, RSD），这是一个多轮框架，利用特权回溯上下文将此类经验转化为密集的监督信号。对于每条同策略轨迹，同一个底层模型同时充当学生和教师：教师在以跨任务先例与经验教训、以及来自已完成轨迹的轮次级反思和未来后见之明为条件的情况下，对学生实际执行的动作进行重新评分。由此得到的教师分布通过同策略自蒸馏被蒸馏回策略之中。在多轮迭代中，经验库不断增长，回溯上下文不断刷新，使模型、其数据及其监督信号得以共同进化。我们进一步引入了前沿引导……（摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出回溯自蒸馏（RSD）多轮框架，让同一模型既当学生又当教师，借助特权回溯上下文将缺乏真值答案或奖励的自我经验转化为密集监督信号，实现模型、数据与监督的共同进化。
en_tdlr: Proposes Retrospective Self-Distillation (RSD), a multi-round framework where the same model serves as both student and teacher, leveraging privileged retrospective context to turn unlabeled self-experience into dense supervision, enabling the model, its data, and its supervision to co-evolve.
